valuePlaceholder: Value; leave empty to remove the header

issue.badKey: Names may only contain letters, digits and symbols such as - _ . (no spaces or colons)
issue.badValue: Values cannot contain line breaks or other control characters
issue.noColon: Missing colon; use the format Key: Value
issue.host: Setting Host here has no effect; to rewrite it, enable "{option}" in Basic settings
issue.managed: This header is managed by the connection; setting it manually is ignored or breaks the transfer
issue.clientIp: A fixed value overrides the real client address; to pass the client IP, enable "{option}" in Basic settings
issue.variable: nginx-style variables are not supported; the value is sent as is
issue.duplicate: Same name as line {line}; the later one wins
issue.remove: Empty value: the header will be removed
issue.ctDefault: Defaults to text/plain; charset=utf-8 when empty
issue.ctFormat: Use the format type/subtype with optional parameters, e.g. text/html; charset=utf-8
issue.ctUnknownType: Uncommon top-level type {type}; check the spelling
issue.ctCharset: No charset declared; non-English text may be garbled. Consider adding ; charset=utf-8

desc.xForwardedProto: Tells the backend the client protocol so it generates https links
desc.xForwardedSsl: Some apps use this to detect HTTPS access
desc.xForwardedPrefix: Lets a backend mounted under a sub-path generate correct links
desc.authorization: Access the backend with fixed credentials
desc.xApiKey: Access the backend with a fixed API key
desc.acceptEncoding: Remove or set to identity to get uncompressed responses from the backend
desc.origin: Remove to stop backends rejecting requests from a different origin (e.g. WebSocket)
desc.referer: Hide the referring page from the backend
desc.cookie: Do not send client cookies to the backend
desc.acceptLanguage: Fix the language the backend responds in
desc.reqCacheControl: Ask the backend not to use its cache
desc.hsts: Make browsers use HTTPS only for this site
desc.xFrameOptions: Restrict embedding the page in iframes on other sites, preventing clickjacking
desc.xContentTypeOptions: Stop browsers from guessing the content type
desc.referrerPolicy: Control the referrer information sent when navigating to other sites
desc.csp: Restrict where scripts, styles and other resources may load from
desc.permissionsPolicy: Disable browser features such as camera, microphone and geolocation
desc.corp: Restrict other sites from using this site's resources
desc.respCacheControl: Control how browsers and CDNs cache responses
desc.acao: Origins allowed for cross-origin requests; to allow all, just turn on the CORS switch
desc.contentDisposition: Make the browser display or download the file
desc.xXssProtection: XSS filter of old browsers; 0 is recommended today
